title: ranunculus cornutus var. leiocarpus
intro: Ranunculus cornutus var. leiocarpus, commonly known as the mountain buttercup, is a plant species found in the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The health benefits of mountain buttercup include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic agent, while its therapeutic actions include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of mountain buttercup include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
